title: Guiding Vector Field Generation via Score-based Diffusion Model
summary: Guiding Vector Fields (GVFs) are a powerful tool for robotic path following. However, classical methods assume smooth, ordered curves and fail when paths are unordered, multi-branch, or generated by probabilistic models. We propose a unified framework, termed the Score-Induced Guiding Vector Field (SGVF), which leverages score-based generative modeling to construct vector fields directly from data distributions. SGVF learns tangent fields from point clouds with unit-norm, orthogonality, and directional-consistency losses, ensuring geometric fidelity and control feasibility. This approach removes the reliance on ad-hoc path segmentation and enables guidance along complex topologies such as branching and pseudo-manifolds. The study establishes a correspondence between score vanishing in diffusion models and GVF singularities and highlights representational capacity near sharp path curvatures. Experiments on robotic navigation in planar environments demonstrate that SGVF achieves reliable path following in scenarios where classical GVFs fail, underscoring its potential as a bridge between generative modeling and geometric control. Code and experiment video are available at https://github.com/czr-gif/Guiding-Vector-Field-Generation-via-Score-based-Diffusion-Model.
tldr: Proposes Score-Induced Guiding Vector Field (SGVF), which uses a score-based diffusion model to generate guiding vector fields for robotic path following from unordered or probabilistic data, enabling navigation on complex topologies.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于分数扩散模型的引导向量场（SGVF）生成方法，用于从无序点云生成机器人路径跟随的向量场，实现在复杂拓扑结构上的导航。
summary_zh: 引导向量场（GVF）是机器人路径跟踪的强大工具。然而，经典方法假设路径为光滑有序曲线，当路径无序、多分支或由概率模型生成时，这些方法将失效。我们提出了一种统一框架，称为基于分数的引导向量场（SGVF），该框架利用基于分数的生成建模，直接从数据分布中构建向量场。SGVF通过单位范数、正交性和方向一致性损失，从点云中学习切线场，确保几何保真度与控制可行性。这一方法消除了对特定路径分割的依赖，并能够沿复杂拓扑结构（如分支路径和伪流形）进行引导。本研究建立了扩散模型中分数消失与GVF奇点之间的对应关系，并强调了该方法在尖锐路径曲率附近的表征能力。在平面环境下的机器人导航实验中，SGVF在经典GVF失效的场景下实现了可靠的路径跟踪，凸显了其作为生成建模与几何控制之间桥梁的潜力。代码与实验视频可在 https://github.com/czr-gif/Guiding-Vector-Field-Generation-via-Score-based-Diffusion-Model 获取。

title: $M^2$-VLA: Boosting Vision-Language Models for Generalizable Manipulation via Layer Mixture and Meta-Skills
summary: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models predominantly rely on end-to-end fine-tuning. While effective, this paradigm compromises the inherent generalization capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and incurs catastrophic forgetting. To address these limitations, we propose $M^2$-VLA, which demonstrates that a generalized VLM is able to serve as a powerful backbone for robotic manipulation directly. However, it remains a key challenge to bridge the gap between the high-level semantic understanding of VLMs and the precise requirements of robotic control. To overcome this, we introduce the Mixture of Layers (MoL) strategy that selectively extracts task-critical information from dense semantic features. Furthermore, to facilitate efficient trajectory learning under constrained model capacity, we propose a Meta Skill Module (MSM) that integrates strong inductive biases. Extensive experiments in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, generalization and ablation studies validate the architecture's zero-shot capabilities and confirm the contribution of each key component. Our code and pre-trained models will be made publicly available.
tldr: Proposes M^2-VLA, a novel architecture using a Mixture of Layers strategy and a Meta Skill Module to enable a generalist Vision-Language Model to directly control robot manipulation with improved generalization and less forgetting.
tldr_zh: 提出M^2-VLA架构，通过层混合策略和元技能模块，使通用视觉语言模型能直接用于机器人操控，提升泛化能力并减少灾难性遗忘。
summary_zh: 当前的视觉-语言-动作模型主要依赖端到端的微调方法。虽然这种方式有效，但它削弱了视觉语言模型固有的泛化能力，并引发了灾难性遗忘问题。为应对这些局限性，我们提出 $M^2$-VLA 模型，证明广义的视觉语言模型能够直接作为机器人操作的强大骨干网络。然而，如何弥合视觉语言模型的高层语义理解与机器人控制的精确需求之间的差距，仍是关键挑战。为此，我们引入了混合分层策略，能够从密集语义特征中有选择地提取任务关键信息。此外，为在有限模型容量下实现高效轨迹学习，我们提出了一种集成强归纳偏置的元技能模块。在仿真和真实环境中的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。泛化与消融研究进一步证实了该架构的零样本能力，并明确了各关键组件的贡献。我们的代码与预训练模型将公开发布。

title: MotionBricks: Scalable Real-Time Motions with Modular Latent Generative Model and Smart Primitives
summary: Despite transformative advances in generative motion synthesis, real-time interactive motion control remains dominated by traditional techniques. In this work, we identify two key challenges in bridging research and production: 1) Real-time scalability: Industry applications demand real-time generation of a vast repertoire of motion skills, while generative methods exhibit significant degradation in quality and scalability under real-time computation constraints, and 2) Integration: Industry applications demand fine-grained multi-modal control involving velocity commands, style selection, and precise keyframes, a need largely unmet by existing text- or tag-driven models. To overcome these limitations, we introduce MotionBricks: a large-scale, real-time generative framework with a two-fold solution. First, we propose a large-scale modular latent generative backbone tailored for robust real-time motion generation, effectively modeling a dataset of over 350,000 motion clips with a single model. Second, we introduce smart primitives that provide a unified, robust, and intuitive interface for authoring both navigation and object interaction. Applications can be designed in a plug-and-play manner like assembling bricks without expert animation knowledge. Quantitatively, we show that MotionBricks produces state-of-the-art motion quality on open-source and proprietary datasets of various scales, while also achieving a real-time throughput of 15,000 FPS with 2ms latency. We demonstrate the flexibility and robustness of MotionBricks in a complete production-level animation demo, covering navigation and object-scene interaction across various styles with a unified model. To showcase our framework's application beyond animation, we deploy MotionBricks on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot to demonstrate its flexibility and generalization for real-time robotic control.
tldr: MotionBricks is a real-time generative framework for motion synthesis, featuring a modular latent model and smart primitives for animation. It is also demonstrated on a humanoid robot for real-time control.
tldr_zh: MotionBricks是一个用于运动合成的实时生成框架，包含模块化潜在模型和智能基元，用于动画制作，并在人形机器人上进行了实时控制演示。
summary_zh: 尽管生成式运动合成技术已取得变革性进展，实时交互式运动控制领域仍主要由传统技术主导。本研究指出连接研究与生产应用的两大核心挑战：1）实时可扩展性：工业应用需实时生成大规模运动技能库，而生成式方法在实时计算约束下存在显著的质量与可扩展性下降；2）集成性：工业应用需要涉及速度指令、风格选择与精确关键帧的细粒度多模态控制，现有文本或标签驱动模型大多无法满足该需求。为突破这些局限，我们提出MotionBricks：一个具备双重解决方案的大规模实时生成框架。首先，我们设计了一种专为鲁棒实时运动生成定制的大规模模块化潜空间生成主干网络，可单模型高效建模超35万条运动片段数据集。其次，我们引入智能基元技术，为导航与物体交互创作提供统一、鲁棒且直观的接口，用户无需专业动画知识即可通过类似积木拼装的即插即用方式设计应用。量化实验表明，MotionBricks在不同规模的开源与专有数据集上均取得业界领先的运动生成质量，同时实现15,000 FPS的实时吞吐量与2毫秒延迟。我们在完整生产级动画演示中验证了框架的灵活性与鲁棒性，通过单一模型实现多风格导航及物体-场景交互。为展示框架在动画之外的拓展应用，我们将MotionBricks部署于宇树G1人形机器人，验证其在实时机器人控制中的灵活性与泛化能力。

title: Exploiting Differential Flatness for Efficient Learning-based Model Predictive Control of Constrained Multi-Input Control Affine Systems
summary: Learning-based control techniques use data from past trajectories to control systems with uncertain dynamics. However, learning-based controllers are often computationally inefficient, limiting their practicality. To address this limitation, we propose a learning-based controller that exploits differential flatness, a property of many robotic systems. Recent research on using flatness for learning-based control either is limited in that it (i) ignores input constraints, (ii) applies only to single-input systems, or (iii) is tailored to specific platforms. In contrast, our approach uses a system extension and block-diagonal cost formulation to control general multi-input, nonlinear, affine systems. Furthermore, it satisfies input and half-space flat state constraints and guarantees probabilistic Lyapunov decrease using only two sequential convex optimizations. We show that our approach performs similarly to, but is multiple times more efficient than, a Gaussian process model predictive controller in simulation, and achieves competitive tracking in real hardware experiments.
tldr: This paper proposes a computationally efficient learning-based Model Predictive Control method that exploits differential flatness for constrained, multi-input robotic systems, demonstrating performance in simulation and hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种利用微分平坦特性的高效学习型模型预测控制方法，用于具有约束的多输入机器人系统，并在仿真和硬件实验中验证了性能。
summary_zh: 基于学习的控制技术利用过去轨迹的数据来控制动力学不确定的系统。然而，基于学习的控制器往往计算效率低下，限制了其实际应用。为解决这一局限，我们提出一种利用微分平坦性的学习型控制器，该特性普遍存在于多种机器人系统中。近期基于平坦性的学习控制研究存在以下局限：（一）忽略输入约束，（二）仅适用于单输入系统，或（三）针对特定平台定制。相比之下，我们的方法通过系统扩展与块对角成本公式，实现了对通用多输入非线性仿射系统的控制。此外，该方法能够满足输入约束与半空间平坦状态约束，并仅通过两次顺序凸优化即可保证概率意义下的李雅普诺夫递减。仿真结果表明，我们的方法在性能上与高斯过程模型预测控制器相当，但计算效率提升数倍，并在实际硬件实验中实现了具有竞争力的轨迹跟踪性能。

title: Learning Human-Intention Priors from Large-Scale Human Demonstrations for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Human videos contain rich manipulation priors, but using them for robot learning remains difficult because raw observations entangle scene understanding, human motion, and embodiment-specific action. We introduce MoT-HRA, a hierarchical vision-language-action framework that learns human-intention priors from large-scale human demonstrations. We first curate HA-2.2M, a 2.2M-episode action-language dataset reconstructed from heterogeneous human videos through hand-centric filtering, spatial reconstruction, temporal segmentation, and language alignment. On top of this dataset, MoT-HRA factorizes manipulation into three coupled experts: a vision-language expert predicts an embodiment-agnostic 3D trajectory, an intention expert models MANO-style hand motion as a latent human-motion prior, and a fine expert maps the intention-aware representation to robot action chunks. A shared-attention trunk and read-only key-value transfer allow downstream control to use human priors while limiting interference with upstream representations. Experiments on hand motion generation, simulated manipulation, and real-world robot tasks show that MoT-HRA improves motion plausibility and robust control under distribution shift.
tldr: This paper introduces MoT-HRA, a hierarchical vision-language-action framework that learns human-intention priors from large-scale human demonstrations to improve robot manipulation. It involves a new dataset (HA-2.2M) and a method that decomposes manipulation into coupled experts for trajectory prediction, hand motion modeling, and robot action mapping, demonstrating improvements in simulated and real-world robot tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MoT-HRA，一种从大规模人类演示中学习人类意图先验的分层视觉-语言-动作框架，旨在改进机器人操作。它包含一个新的数据集（HA-2.2M）和一个将操作分解为耦合专家的方法，用于轨迹预测、手部运动建模和机器人动作映射，在模拟和真实世界机器人任务中展示了性能提升。
summary_zh: 人类视频蕴含着丰富的操作先验知识，但将其用于机器人学习仍面临困难，因为原始观测数据混合了场景理解、人体运动与具身特定动作。我们提出MoT-HRA——一种分层视觉-语言-动作框架，能够从大规模人类演示数据中学习人类意图先验。我们首先构建HA-2.2M数据集，该数据集包含220万条动作-语言样本，通过手部中心筛选、空间重建、时序分割和语言对齐等技术从异构人类视频中重构而成。基于此数据集，MoT-HRA将操作任务分解为三个协同工作的专家模块：视觉语言专家预测与具身无关的三维轨迹，意图专家将MANO风格的手部运动建模为潜在人类运动先验，精细专家则将意图感知表征映射为机器人动作组块。通过共享注意力主干网络和只读键值传递机制，下游控制系统能够利用人类先验知识，同时限制对上游表征的干扰。在手部运动生成、模拟操作和真实机器人任务上的实验表明，MoT-HRA在分布偏移条件下显著提升了运动合理性与鲁棒控制性能。

title: Agent-Centric Visual Reinforcement Learning under Dynamic Perturbations
summary: Visual reinforcement learning aims to empower an agent to learn policies from visual observations, yet it remains vulnerable to dynamic visual perturbations, such as unpredictable shifts in corruption types. To systematically study this, we introduce the Visual Degraded Control Suite (VDCS), a benchmark extending DeepMind Control Suite with Markov-switching degradations to simulate non-stationary real-world perturbations. Experiments on VDCS reveal severe performance degradation in existing methods. We theoretically prove via information-theoretic analysis that this failure stems from reconstruction-based objectives inevitably entangling perturbation artifacts into latent representations. To mitigate this negative impact, we propose Agent-Centric Observations with Mixture-of-Experts (ACO-MoE) to robustify visual RL against perturbations. The proposed framework leverages unique agent-centric restoration experts, achieving restoration from corruptions and task-relevant foreground extraction, thereby decoupling perception from perturbation before being processed by the RL agent. Extensive experiments on VDCS show our ACO-MoE outperforms strong baselines, recovering 95.3% of clean performance under challenging Markov-switching corruptions. Moreover, it achieves SOTA results on DMControl Generalization with random-color and video-background perturbations, demonstrating a high level of robustness.
tldr: This paper introduces a method and benchmark for robust visual reinforcement learning under non-stationary visual perturbations, focusing on control tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文针对非平稳视觉干扰下的控制任务，提出了一种鲁棒视觉强化学习方法并引入了相应基准。
summary_zh: 视觉强化学习旨在使智能体能够从视觉观测中学习策略，但其仍易受动态视觉扰动的影响，例如难以预测的退化类型突变。为系统研究此问题，我们提出视觉退化控制基准（VDCS），该基准通过马尔可夫切换退化机制扩展了DeepMind控制套件，以模拟非平稳的现实世界扰动。在VDCS上的实验表明，现有方法均出现严重的性能下降。我们通过信息论分析从理论上证明，这种失败源于基于重构的目标函数不可避免地会将扰动伪影纠缠到潜在表征中。为减轻这种负面影响，我们提出基于专家混合机制的智能体中心观测框架（ACO-MoE），以增强视觉强化学习对扰动的鲁棒性。该框架利用独特的智能体中心修复专家，同时实现退化修复与任务相关前景提取，从而在强化学习智能体处理前将感知与扰动解耦。在VDCS上的大量实验表明，ACO-MoE优于现有基线方法，在具有挑战性的马尔可夫切换退化条件下恢复了95.3%的干净性能。此外，该方法在随机颜色和视频背景扰动下的DMControl泛化基准测试中取得了最先进的成果，展现出高度的鲁棒性。

title: Sliding Mode Control for Safe Trajectory Tracking with Moving Obstacles Avoidance: Experimental Validation on Planar Robots
summary: This paper presents a unified control framework for robust trajectory tracking and moving obstacle avoidance applicable to a broad class of mobile robots. By formulating a generalized kinematic transformation, we convert diverse vehicle dynamics into a strict feedback form, facilitating the design of a Sliding Mode Control (SMC) strategy for precise and robust reference tracking. To ensure operational safety in dynamic environments, the tracking controller is integrated with a Collision Cone Control Barrier Function (C3BF) based safety filter. The proposed architecture guarantees asymptotic tracking in the presence of external disturbances while strictly enforcing collision avoidance constraints. The novelty of this work lies in designing a sliding mode controller for ground robots like the Ackermann drive, which has not been done before. The efficacy and versatility of the approach are validated through numerical simulations and extensive real-world experiments on three distinct platforms: an Ackermann-steered vehicle, a differential drive robot, and a quadrotor drone. Video of the experiments are available at https://youtu.be/dWcxwum96vk
tldr: This paper presents a unified control framework using Sliding Mode Control and a Collision Cone Control Barrier Function for robust trajectory tracking and moving obstacle avoidance on diverse mobile robots, validated through simulations and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种统一控制框架，结合滑模控制和碰撞锥控制屏障函数，用于实现多种移动机器人的鲁棒轨迹跟踪和动态避障，并通过仿真和真实平台实验进行了验证。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于广泛移动机器人的鲁棒轨迹跟踪与动态避障统一控制框架。通过建立广义运动学变换，我们将多种车辆动力学模型转换为严格反馈形式，从而便于设计用于精确鲁棒参考跟踪的滑模控制策略。为确保动态环境中的操作安全性，跟踪控制器与基于碰撞锥控制屏障函数的安全滤波器相集成。该架构在存在外部扰动的情况下保证渐近跟踪性能，同时严格满足避障约束。本研究的创新点在于首次为阿克曼转向式地面机器人设计了滑模控制器。通过数值仿真和在三种不同平台上的大量实际实验验证了该方法的有效性和普适性：包括阿克曼转向车辆、差速驱动机器人以及四旋翼无人机。实验视频见：https://youtu.be/dWcxwum96vk

title: Characterizing Vision-Language-Action Models across XPUs: Constraints and Acceleration for On-Robot Deployment
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are promising for generalist robot control, but on-robot deployment is bottlenecked by real-time inference under tight cost and energy budgets. Most prior evaluations rely on desktop-grade GPUs, obscuring the trade-offs and opportunities offered by heterogeneous edge accelerators (GPUs/XPUs/NPUs). We present a systematic analysis for low-cost VLA deployment via model-hardware co-characterization. First, we build a cross-accelerator leaderboard and evaluate model-hardware pairs under CET (Cost, Energy, Time), showing that right-sized edge devices can be more cost-/energy-efficient than flagship GPUs while meeting control-rate constraints. Second, using in-depth profiling, we uncover a consistent two-phase inference pattern: a compute-bound VLM backbone followed by a memory-bound Action Expert, which induces phase-dependent underutilization and hardware inefficiency. Finally, guided by these insights, we propose DP-Cache and V-AEFusion to reduce diffusion redundancy and enable asynchronous pipeline parallelism, achieving up to 2.9x speedup on GPUs and 6x on edge NPUs with only marginal success degradation. The example leaderboard website is available at: https://vla-leaderboard-01.vercel.app/.
tldr: This paper systematically analyzes hardware deployment challenges for Vision-Language-Action models on edge devices and proposes optimizations to meet real-time constraints for on-robot control.
tldr_zh: 本研究系统分析了VLA模型在边缘设备上的部署挑战，并提出了优化方案，以满足机器人控制的实时性能与能耗约束。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型在通用机器人控制领域展现出巨大潜力，但其在机器人上的部署受到实时推理的制约，尤其是在严苛的成本和能耗预算下。现有研究大多依赖桌面级GPU进行评估，未能充分揭示异构边缘加速器（GPU/XPU/NPUs）所蕴含的权衡与优化空间。本文通过模型-硬件协同特性分析，提出一套面向低成本VLA部署的系统性研究方法。首先，我们构建了跨加速器性能榜单，基于成本、能耗、时间（CET）指标评估模型与硬件的组合效果，结果表明适当规模的边缘设备在满足控制频率约束的同时，可比旗舰级GPU具备更高的成本效益与能效。其次，通过深度性能剖析，我们发现VLA推理呈现一致的两阶段模式：先经过计算密集型的视觉语言模型主干网络，再执行内存密集型的动作专家模块，这种模式导致阶段性资源利用率不足与硬件效率低下。基于此发现，我们提出DP-Cache和V-AEFusion两种优化方法，通过减少扩散冗余并实现异步流水线并行，在GPU上实现最高2.9倍加速，在边缘NPU上实现最高6倍加速，且性能损失极小。示例榜单网站已发布于：https://vla-leaderboard-01.vercel.app/。

title: AsyncShield: A Plug-and-Play Edge Adapter for Asynchronous Cloud-based VLA Navigation
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have been demonstrated possessing strong zero-shot generalization for robot control, their massive parameter sizes typically necessitate cloud-based deployment. However, cloud deployment introduces network jitter and inference latency, which can induce severe spatiotemporal misalignment in mobile navigation under continuous displacement, so that the stale intents expressed in past ego frames may become spatially incorrect in the current frame and lead to collisions. To address this issue, we propose AsyncShield, a plug-and-play asynchronous control framework. AsyncShield discards traditional black-box time-series prediction in favor of a deterministic physical white-box spatial mapping. By maintaining a temporal pose buffer and utilizing kinematic transformations, the system accurately converts temporal lag into spatial pose offsets to restore the VLA's original geometric intent. To balance intent restoration fidelity and physical safety, the edge adaptation is formulated as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP). Solved via the PPO-Lagrangian algorithm, a reinforcement learning adapter dynamically trades off between tracking the VLA intent and responding to high-frequency LiDAR obstacle avoidance hard constraints. Furthermore, benefiting from a standardized universal sub-goal interface, domain randomization, and perception-level adaptation via Collision Radius Inflation, AsyncShield operates as a lightweight, plug-and-play module. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that, without fine-tuning any cloud-based foundation models, the framework exhibits zero-shot and robust generalization capabilities, effectively improving the success rate and physical safety of asynchronous navigation.
tldr: A plug-and-play edge adapter for cloud-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) navigation systems that compensates for network latency-induced spatiotemporal misalignment by transforming temporal lags into spatial offsets, using a CMDP and RL to balance intent fidelity with safety.
tldr_zh: 用于云端VLA导航系统的即插即用边缘适配器，通过将网络延迟转化为空间位姿偏移来补偿时空错位，使用CMDP和强化学习来平衡意图保真度与安全性。
summary_zh: 尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已被证明在机器人控制中具有强大的零样本泛化能力，但其庞大的参数量通常需要基于云的部署。然而，云部署会引入网络抖动和推理延迟，这可能导致连续位移下的移动导航产生严重的时空错位，使得在过往自视角帧中表达的陈旧意图在当前帧中空间位置失效，从而引发碰撞。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AsyncShield，一种即插即用的异步控制框架。AsyncShield摒弃了传统的黑盒时间序列预测，转而采用确定性的物理白盒空间映射方法。通过维护时间姿态缓冲区并利用运动学变换，系统能够将时间延迟精确转换为空间姿态偏移，从而恢复VLA原有的几何意图。为了平衡意图恢复的准确性与物理安全性，边缘适配被建模为一个约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）。通过PPO-Lagrangian算法求解，强化学习适配器能够在跟踪VLA意图与响应高频激光雷达避障硬约束之间进行动态权衡。此外，受益于标准化的通用子目标接口、领域随机化以及通过碰撞半径膨胀实现的感知层适配，AsyncShield能够作为一个轻量级、即插即用的模块运行。仿真与实际环境实验表明，该框架无需微调任何基于云的基础模型，即可展现出零样本且鲁棒的泛化能力，有效提升了异步导航的成功率与物理安全性。

title: Multi-Robot Motions in Milliseconds: Vector-Accelerated Primitives for Sampling-Based Planning
summary: In this paper, we extend the recent Vector-Accelerated Motion Planning (VAMP) framework to multi-robot motion planning (MRMP). We develop two vector-accelerated primitives, multi-robot MotionValidation (MotVal) and FindFirstConflict (FFC), which exploit SIMD parallelism within the multi-robot domain. On pure multi-robot motion validation tests, this achieves over 1100X speedup in validation time. Additionally, we modify a representative set of MRMP algorithms to use these new primitives. The relative speedup for each algorithm is studied on scenarios with manipulator, rigid body, and heterogeneous teams with some instances producing multi-robot solutions in the order of milliseconds and, in many cases, shows planning time speedups of over 850X.
tldr: This paper presents vector-accelerated primitives for multi-robot motion planning, achieving over 1000x speedup in validation and enabling planning in milliseconds.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了用于多机器人运动规划的向量加速原语，在验证上实现了超过1000倍的加速，并使规划时间达到毫秒级。
summary_zh: 本文拓展了近期提出的矢量加速运动规划框架，将其应用于多机器人运动规划领域。我们开发了两种矢量加速原语——多机器人运动验证与首次冲突检测，这两种原语充分利用了多机器人领域内的单指令多数据并行计算能力。在纯多机器人运动验证测试中，该方法实现了超过1100倍的验证速度提升。此外，我们改良了一系列具有代表性的多机器人运动规划算法，使其能够运用这些新型原语。通过对机械臂、刚体及异构机器人团队等多种场景的算法性能测试，部分实例可在毫秒级时间内生成多机器人运动规划方案，多数案例显示出超过850倍的规划时间加速比。

title: Cooptimizing Safety and Performance Using Safety Value-Constrained Model Predictive Control
summary: Autonomous systems are increasingly deployed in real-world environments, where they must achieve high performance while maintaining safety under state and input constraints. Although Model Predictive Control (MPC) provides a principled framework for constrained optimal control, guaranteeing safety beyond its finite planning horizon remains a fundamental challenge. In this work, we augment MPC with a safety value function-based terminal constraint that enforces membership in a control-invariant safe set at the end of each planning horizon. This formulation enables real-time synthesis of trajectories that are both high-performing and provably safe. We show that, under an exact safety value function and a feasible initialization, the proposed MPC scheme is recursively feasible, thereby ensuring persistent safety. In contrast to traditional terminal set constructions that rely on local linearizations or conservative approximations, our approach incorporates a reachability-based safety value function for terminal constraints, yielding less conservative and more expressive safety guarantees. We validate the proposed framework through simulation and hardware experiments on a Flexiv Rizon 10s manipulator. Results demonstrate improved constraint satisfaction and robustness compared to standard state-constrained MPC and reactive safety filtering, while maintaining competitive task performance. The full implementation and experiments are available on the project website.
tldr: Proposes a safety-constrained MPC framework using a safety value function for terminal constraints, ensuring persistent safety and high performance, validated on a robot manipulator.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于安全值函数终端约束的安全约束模型预测控制框架，确保持续安全性和高性能，并在机器人操作臂上进行了验证。
summary_zh:
摘要：
自主系统越来越多地应用于现实环境中，它们必须在状态和输入约束下保持高性能的同时确保安全性。尽管模型预测控制（MPC）为约束优化控制提供了一个理论框架，但如何保证其有限规划时域外的安全性仍是一个根本性挑战。本研究通过引入基于安全价值函数的终端约束对MPC进行增强，该约束强制要求每个规划周期结束时系统状态处于控制不变的安全集中。此方法能够实时合成兼具高性能与可证明安全性的轨迹。我们证明，在精确安全价值函数和可行初始化的条件下，所提出的MPC方案具有递归可行性，从而确保持续安全性。相较于依赖局部线性化或保守逼近的传统终端集构造方法，我们的方法通过将基于可达性分析的安全价值函数纳入终端约束，获得了更少保守性且更具表现力的安全保证。我们在Flexiv Rizon 10s机械臂上通过仿真和硬件实验验证了该框架，结果显示相较于标准状态约束MPC和反应式安全滤波方法，所提方法在保持竞争力的任务性能同时，显著提升了约束满足度与鲁棒性。完整实现与实验数据已在项目网站公开。

title: CF-VLA: Efficient Coarse-to-Fine Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies offer strong expressivity for action generation, but suffer from a fundamental inefficiency: multi-step inference is required to recover action structure from uninformative Gaussian noise, leading to a poor efficiency-quality trade-off under real-time constraints. We address this issue by rethinking the role of the starting point in generative action modeling. Instead of shortening the sampling trajectory, we propose CF-VLA, a coarse-to-fine two-stage formulation that restructures action generation into a coarse initialization step that constructs an action-aware starting point, followed by a single-step local refinement that corrects residual errors. Concretely, the coarse stage learns a conditional posterior over endpoint velocity to transform Gaussian noise into a structured initialization, while the fine stage performs a fixed-time refinement from this initialization. To stabilize training, we introduce a stepwise strategy that first learns a controlled coarse predictor and then performs joint optimization. Experiments on CALVIN and LIBERO show that our method establishes a strong efficiency-performance frontier under low-NFE (Number of Function Evaluations) regimes: it consistently outperforms existing NFE=2 methods, matches or surpasses the NFE=10 $π_{0.5}$ baseline on several metrics, reduces action sampling latency by 75.4%, and achieves the best average real-robot success rate of 83.0%, outperforming MIP by 19.5 points and $π_{0.5}$ by 4.0 points. These results suggest that structured, coarse-to-fine generation enables both strong performance and efficient inference. Our code is available at https://github.com/EmbodiedAI-RoboTron/CF-VLA.
tldr: This paper proposes CF-VLA, a coarse-to-fine action generation method for Vision-Language-Action policies that improves inference efficiency and robot performance by restructuring the sampling process.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CF-VLA，一种用于视觉-语言-动作策略的从粗到细的动作生成方法，通过重构采样过程，提高了推理效率与机器人性能。
summary_zh: 基于流的视觉语言动作（VLA）策略在动作生成方面具有强大的表达能力，但存在一个根本性的效率问题：需要多步推理才能从无信息的高斯噪声中恢复动作结构，导致在实时约束下效率与质量难以兼顾。我们通过重新思考生成式动作建模中起始点的作用来解决这一问题。不同于缩短采样轨迹，我们提出了CF-VLA——一种从粗到精的两阶段框架，将动作生成重构为一个构建动作感知起始点的粗粒度初始化步骤，以及一个纠正残差的单步局部精修步骤。具体而言，粗粒度阶段学习端点速度的条件后验分布，将高斯噪声转换为结构化初始化；而精细阶段则从该初始化出发进行固定时长的精修。为稳定训练，我们引入分步策略：先学习一个可控的粗粒度预测器，再进行联合优化。在CALVIN和LIBERO数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法在低NFE（函数评估次数）机制下建立了优越的效率-性能边界：它始终优于现有NFE=2的方法，在多项指标上达到或超越NFE=10的$π_{0.5}$基线，将动作采样延迟降低75.4%，并在真实机器人任务中取得了83.0%的平均成功率，分别超过MIP方法19.5个百分点和$π_{0.5}$基线4.0个百分点。这些结果表明，结构化的从粗到精生成方式能够同时实现高性能和高效推理。我们的代码已发布于https://github.com/EmbodiedAI-RoboTron/CF-VLA。

title: AgenticCache: Cache-Driven Asynchronous Planning for Embodied AI Agents
summary: Embodied AI agents increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) for planning, yet per-step LLM calls impose severe latency and cost. In this paper, we show that embodied tasks exhibit strong plan locality, where the next plan is largely predictable from the current one. Building on this, we introduce AgenticCache, a planning framework that reuses cached plans to avoid per-step LLM calls. In AgenticCache, each agent queries a runtime cache of frequent plan transitions, while a background Cache Updater asynchronously calls the LLM to validate and refine cached entries. Across four multi-agent embodied benchmarks, AgenticCache improves task success rate by 22% on average across 12 configurations (4 benchmarks x 3 models), reduces simulation latency by 65%, and lowers token usage by 50%. Cache-based plan reuse thus offers a practical path to low-latency, low-cost embodied agents. Code is available at https://github.com/hojoonleokim/MLSys26_AgenticCache.
tldr: AgenticCache is a framework that reduces LLM call latency and cost for embodied AI planning by reusing cached plans based on plan locality, improving task success and efficiency.
tldr_zh: AgenticCache 是一个用于具身AI的规划框架，通过重用缓存的计划来减少LLM调用延迟和成本，基于计划局部性，提高了任务成功率和效率。
summary_zh: 具身人工智能智能体日益依赖大语言模型进行规划，但每一步都调用大语言模型会带来严重的延迟和成本问题。本文发现，具身任务表现出强烈的规划局部性，即下一个规划在很大程度上可由当前规划预测。基于此，我们提出了AgenticCache规划框架，该框架通过复用缓存规划来避免每一步调用大语言模型。在AgenticCache中，每个智能体查询一个运行时缓存来获取高频的规划转换信息，同时后台的缓存更新器异步调用大语言模型来验证和优化缓存条目。在四个多智能体具身基准测试中，AgenticCache在12种配置（4个基准测试×3种模型）下平均提升了22%的任务成功率，降低了65%的模拟延迟，并减少了50%的令牌使用量。因此，基于缓存的规划复用为实现低延迟、低成本的具身智能体提供了一条可行路径。代码可在https://github.com/hojoonleokim/MLSys26_AgenticCache获取。

title: Pushing Radar Odometry Beyond the Pavement: Current Capabilities and Challenges
summary: Radar offers unique advantages for localization in unstructured environments, including robustness to weather, lighting, and airborne particulates. While most prior work has studied radar odometry in urban, largely planar settings, its performance in off-road environments remains less understood. In this paper, we investigate the potential of radar for off-road odometry estimation and identify key challenges that arise from full $SE(3)$ vehicle motion, terrain-induced ground returns, and sparse or unstable features. To address these issues, we introduce two simple baselines: Radar-KISSICP, which applies motion compensation to generate 3D-aware radar pointclouds, and Radar-IMU, which leverages IMU preintegration to stabilize scan matching. Experiments on the Great Outdoors (GO) dataset demonstrate that these baselines improve trajectory estimation in challenging routes and provide a reference point for future development of radar odometry in off-road robotics.
tldr: Investigates radar-based odometry for off-road robotics, introducing two baselines to address challenges of 3D motion and sparse features.
tldr_zh: 探索雷达里程计在越野机器人中的应用，针对3D运动和稀疏特征等挑战，提出了两种基准方法。
summary_zh:
摘要：
雷达在非结构化环境中展现出独特的定位优势，包括对天气、光照和空气颗粒物的强鲁棒性。尽管先前研究大多集中于城市环境中（主要为平面场景）的雷达里程计，其在越野环境中的性能表现仍鲜有深入探讨。本文探究了雷达在越野里程计估计中的潜力，并揭示了由完整$SE(3)$车辆运动、地形引起的地面回波以及稀疏或不稳定特征所引发的关键挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了两种简易基准方法：Radar-KISSICP（通过运动补偿生成具有三维感知能力的雷达点云）和Radar-IMU（利用IMU预积分技术稳定扫描匹配）。基于Great Outdoors（GO）数据集的实验表明，这些基准方法在挑战性路线上提升了轨迹估计精度，并为未来越野机器人雷达里程计的发展提供了参考基准。

title: SPLIT: Separating Physical-Contact via Latent Arithmetic in Image-Based Tactile Sensors
summary: Training machine learning models for robotic tactile sensing requires vast amounts of data, yet obtaining realistic interaction data remains a challenge due to physical complexity and variability. Simulating tactile sensors is thus a crucial step in accelerating progress. This paper presents SPLIT, a novel method for simulating image-based tactile sensors, with a primary focus on the DIGIT sensor. Central to our approach is a latent space arithmetic strategy that explicitly disentangles contact geometry from sensor-specific optical properties. Unlike methods that require recalibration for every new unit, this disentanglement allows SPLIT to adapt to diverse DIGIT backgrounds and even transfer data to distinct sensors like the GelSight R1.5 without full model retraining. Beyond this adaptability, our approach achieves faster inference speeds than existing alternatives. Furthermore, we provide a calibrated finite element method (FEM) soft-body mesh simulation with variable resolution, offering a tunable trade-off between speed and fidelity. Additionally, our algorithm supports bidirectional simulation, allowing for both the generation of realistic images from deformation meshes and the reconstruction of meshes from tactile images. This versatility makes SPLIT a valuable tool for accelerating progress in robotic tactile sensing research.
tldr: Proposes SPLIT, a method for simulating image-based tactile sensors via latent space arithmetic that disentangles contact geometry from optical properties, enabling adaptable and fast simulation for robotic tactile sensing.
tldr_zh: 提出SPLIT方法，通过潜在空间算术分离接触几何与光学特性，实现对图像式触觉传感器的仿真，适用于机器人触觉感知研究。
summary_zh: 训练机器人触觉感知的机器学习模型需要大量数据，但受限于物理复杂性和多变性，获取真实交互数据仍具挑战性。因此，模拟触觉传感器成为加速研究进展的关键步骤。本文提出一种新型图像触觉传感器模拟方法SPLIT，主要面向DIGIT传感器。该方法的核心在于潜空间算术策略，能够将接触几何形态与传感器特定光学特性进行显式解耦。与需要针对每个新单元重新校准的方法不同，这种解耦机制使SPLIT能适应不同DIGIT传感器背景，甚至可将数据迁移至GelSight R1.5等异质传感器而无需完整模型重训练。除了适应性强，本方法还实现了比现有方案更快的推理速度。此外，我们提供具有可变分辨率的校准有限元法软体网格模拟，可在速度与保真度之间实现可调平衡。值得注意的是，算法支持双向模拟：既能从变形网格生成逼真图像，也能从触觉图像重建三维网格。这种多功能特性使SPLIT成为加速机器人触觉感知研究进展的重要工具。

title: Generalizable Friction Coefficient Estimation via Material Embedding and Proxy Interaction Modeling
summary: Accurately estimating friction coefficients between arbitrary material pairs is critical for robotics, digital fabrication, and physics-based simulation, but exhaustive pairwise testing scales quadratically with the number of materials. We introduce a proxy-based modeling framework that approximates any pairwise friction $f(A,B)$ from a small, fixed set of proxy materials $C=[c_1,\dots,c_k]$ by learning a per-material embedding $z_A = g(f(A,c1),\dots,f(A,ck))$ and a fusion function $p$ such that $f(A,B)\approx p\big(z_A,z_B\big)$. We present deterministic and probabilistic realizations of $g$ and $p$, procedures for selecting diverse proxy sets, and mechanisms for handling missing or noisy proxy measurements. The learned embeddings are compact, interpretable, and enable calibrated uncertainty estimates for downstream decision making. On simulated and measured friction datasets, our approach achieves high predictive accuracy, robust performance with partial observations, and substantial experimental savings by significantly reducing pairwise testing.
tldr: Presents a framework for estimating friction coefficients between arbitrary material pairs using proxy materials, learning per-material embeddings and a fusion function to predict pairwise friction, reducing the need for exhaustive testing.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种使用代理材料估算任意材料对摩擦系数的框架，通过为每种材料学习一个嵌入表示和一个融合函数来预测成对摩擦，从而减少详尽的测试需求。
summary_zh: 准确估计任意材料对之间的摩擦系数对于机器人学、数字制造和基于物理的仿真至关重要，但详尽的成对测试成本随材料数量呈平方级增长。我们提出一种基于代理材料的建模框架，通过选取少量固定代理材料集 $C=[c_1,\dots,c_k]$，学习各材料的嵌入表示 $z_A = g(f(A,c1),\dots,f(A,ck))$ 与融合函数 $p$，使得任意材料对的摩擦系数可通过 $f(A,B)\approx p\big(z_A,z_B\big)$ 近似计算。我们提出了 $g$ 与 $p$ 的确定性和概率性实现方法、多样化代理集的选取策略，以及处理代理测量数据缺失或噪声的机制。学习得到的嵌入表示具有紧凑性、可解释性，并能支持下游决策所需的校准不确定性估计。在模拟与实测摩擦数据集上的实验表明，该方法实现了高预测精度、对部分观测数据的鲁棒性，并通过显著减少成对测试需求大幅节约了实验成本。

title: Event-based SLAM Benchmark for High-Speed Maneuvers
summary: Event-based cameras are bio-inspired sensors with pixels that independently and asynchronously respond to brightness changes at microsecond resolution, offering the potential to handle visual tasks in high-speed maneuvering scenarios. Existing event-based approaches, although successful in mitigating motion blur caused by high-speed maneuvers, suffer from many limitations. Some of them highlight a success of pose tracking for a fronto-parallel fast shaking camera closed to the structure, while others assume pure (optionally aggressive) three-degree-of-freedom rotations. The former requires persistent local map visibility within the field of view (FOV), whereas the latter fails to generalize to six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) motions where both linear and angular velocities may be large. Consequently, current successes do not fully demonstrate that event-based state estimation under arbitrary aggressive maneuvers is a fully solved problem. To quantitatively assess the extent to which the potential of event cameras has been unlocked, we conduct a thorough analysis of state-of-the-art (SOTA) event-based visual odometry (VO)/visual-inertial odometry (VIO) methods and report shortcomings in current public datasets. Furthermore, we introduce a benchmarking framework for event-based state estimation, called EvSLAM, characterized by sufficient variation in data collection platforms, diverse extreme lighting scenarios, and a wide scope of challenging motion patterns under a clear and rigorous definition of high-speed maneuvers for mobile robots, along with a novel evaluation metric designed to fairly assess the operational limits of event-based solutions. This framework benchmarks state-of-the-art methods, yielding insights into optimal architectures and persistent challenges.
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmarking framework called EvSLAM to evaluate event-based visual SLAM/VO/VIO methods for mobile robots under high-speed, aggressive maneuvers and challenging lighting conditions, highlighting current limitations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了名为EvSLAM的基准测试框架，用于在高速、剧烈运动和极端光照条件下评估移动机器人的事件视觉SLAM/VO/VIO方法，并指出了当前方法的局限性。
summary_zh: 事件相机是一种仿生传感器，其像素能够以微秒级分辨率独立且异步地响应亮度变化，为高速机动场景下的视觉任务处理提供了潜力。现有基于事件的方法虽能有效缓解高速机动导致的运动模糊，但仍存在诸多局限。部分方法在靠近结构的前向平行快速抖动相机姿态跟踪中取得成效，而另一些方法则假设存在纯粹（或具攻击性）的三自由度旋转。前者要求视场范围内持续可见局部地图，后者则无法推广到线速度和角速度均可能较大的六自由度运动场景。因此，当前成果尚未充分证明基于事件的任意攻击性机动状态估计已成为完全解决的问题。为定量评估事件相机潜力的开发程度，我们对前沿的事件视觉里程计/视觉惯性里程计方法进行了系统分析，并指出当前公开数据集的不足。此外，我们提出了一套名为EvSLAM的基于事件状态估计基准框架，其特点包括：数据采集平台具有充分多样性、涵盖多种极端光照场景、在清晰严谨的移动机器人高速机动定义下包含广泛挑战性运动模式，并设计了一种新型评估指标以公平评判基于事件解决方案的性能极限。该框架对前沿方法进行基准测试，从而揭示最优架构设计与尚存的持续性挑战。

title: Interoceptive machine framework: Toward interoception-inspired regulatory architectures in artificial intelligence
summary: This review proposes an integrative framework grounded on interoception and embodied AI-termed the interoceptive machine framework-that translates biologically inspired principles of internal-state regulation into computational architectures for adaptive autonomy. Interoception, conceived as the monitoring, integration, and regulation of internal signals, has proven relevant for understanding adaptive behavior in biological systems. The proposed framework organizes interoceptive contributions into three functional principles: homeostatic, allostatic, and enactive, each associated with distinct computational roles: internal viability regulation, anticipatory uncertainty-based re-evaluation, and active data generation through interaction. These principles are not intended as direct neurophysiological mappings, but as abstractions that inform the design of artificial agents with improved self-regulation and context-sensitive behavior. By embedding internal state variables and regulatory loops within these principles, AI systems can achieve more robust decision-making, calibrated uncertainty handling, and adaptive interaction strategies, particularly in uncertain and dynamic environments. This approach provides a concrete and testable pathway toward agents capable of functionally grounded self-regulation, with direct implications for human-computer interaction and assistive technologies. Ultimately, the interoceptive machine framework offers a unifying perspective on how internal-state regulation can enhance autonomy, adaptivity, and robustness in embodied AI systems
tldr: A review proposing an interoceptive machine framework for embodied AI, translating biological principles of internal-state regulation (homeostasis, allostasis, enactment) into computational architectures to improve agent self-regulation and adaptive behavior in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: 一篇综述文章，提出了一个具身AI的内感受器机器框架，将内部状态调节（稳态、变稳态、生成）的生物学原理转化为计算架构，旨在提升智能体在动态环境中的自我调节和适应行为。
summary_zh: 本综述提出一种基于内感受与具身人工智能的整合框架——即"内感受机器框架"——该框架将生物启发的内部状态调控原理转化为适应式自主系统的计算架构。内感受被定义为对内部信号的监测、整合与调控，其对于理解生物系统的适应性行为已被证实具有相关性。该框架将内感受的功能贡献归纳为三个基本原则：稳态、非稳态与生成性，每个原则分别对应不同的计算角色：内部生存性调节、基于预期不确定性的再评估，以及通过交互主动生成数据。这些原则并非直接对应神经生理学映射，而是作为抽象设计范式，用以指导构建具有更强自我调节能力和情境敏感行为的人工智能体。通过将内部状态变量和调控回路嵌入这些原则，人工智能系统能够在不确定和动态环境中实现更稳健的决策、校准化的不确定性处理以及适应性交互策略。该方法为构建具有功能化自我调节能力的智能体提供了具体且可验证的路径，对人机交互与辅助技术具有直接启示意义。最终，内感受机器框架为内部状态调控如何增强具身人工智能系统的自主性、适应性与鲁棒性提供了统一的理论视角。

title: IntentVLM: Open-Vocabulary Intention Recognition through Forward-Inverse Modeling with Video-Language Models
summary: Improving the effectiveness of human-robot interaction requires social robots to accurately infer human goals through robust intention understanding. This challenge is particularly critical in multimodal settings, where agents must integrate heterogeneous signals including text, visual cues to form a coherent interpretation of user intent. This paper presents IntentVLM, a novel two-stage video-language framework designed for open-vocabulary human intention recognition. The approach is inspired by forward-inverse modeling in cognitive science by decomposing intention understanding into goal candidate generation followed by structured inference through selection, effectively reducing hallucinations in latent reasoning. Evaluated on the IntentQA and Inst-IT Bench datasets, IntentVLM achieves state-of-the-art results with up to 80% accuracy, notably surpassing the baseline performance by 30% and matches human performance. Our findings demonstrate that this structured reasoning approach enhances open-vocabulary intention understanding without catastrophic forgetting, offering a robust foundation for human-centered robotics.
tldr: The paper presents IntentVLM, a novel two-stage video-language framework for open-vocabulary human intention recognition using forward-inverse modeling, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出IntentVLM，一种用于开放词汇人类意图识别的新型两阶段视频-语言框架，采用前向-逆向建模，取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 提升人机交互的有效性要求社交机器人能够通过鲁棒的意图理解准确推断人类目标。这一挑战在多模态场景中尤为关键，智能体需要整合文本、视觉线索等异构信号以形成对用户意图的一致解读。本文提出IntentVLM——一个专为开放词汇人类意图识别设计的新型两阶段视频-语言框架。该方法受认知科学中前向-逆向建模思想的启发，将意图理解分解为目标候选生成和基于选择的结构化推理两个阶段，有效减少了潜在推理中的幻觉现象。在IntentQA和Inst-IT Bench数据集上的评估显示，IntentVLM以最高80%的准确率取得了最先进的性能，显著超越基线30%并达到人类水平。我们的研究结果表明，这种结构化推理方法在增强开放词汇意图理解能力的同时避免了灾难性遗忘，为人本机器人技术奠定了坚实基础。

title: SpecRLBench: A Benchmark for Generalization in Specification-Guided Reinforcement Learning
summary: Specification-guided reinforcement learning (RL) provides a principled framework for encoding complex, temporally extended tasks using formal specifications such as linear temporal logic (LTL). While recent methods have shown promising results, their ability to generalize across unseen specifications and diverse environments remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce SpecRLBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate the generalization capabilities of LTL-based specification-guided RL methods. The benchmark spans multiple difficulty levels across navigation and manipulation domains, incorporating both static and dynamic environments, diverse robot dynamics, and varied observation modalities. Through extensive empirical evaluation, we characterize the strengths and limitations of existing approaches and reveal the challenges that emerge as specification and environment complexity increase. SpecRLBench provides a structured platform for systematic comparison and supports the development of more generalizable specification-guided RL methods. Code is available at https://github.com/BU-DEPEND-Lab/SpecRLBench.
tldr: This paper introduces SpecRLBench, a benchmark for evaluating generalization of specification-guided RL using LTL in navigation and manipulation tasks across diverse environments and robot dynamics.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SpecRLBench，这是一个用于评估基于线性时序逻辑（LTL）的规范强化学习方法在导航和操作任务中，跨不同环境和机器人动态的泛化能力的基准测试。
summary_zh:
摘要：
规范引导的强化学习（RL）为使用线性时序逻辑（LTL）等形式化规范编码复杂时序扩展任务提供了原理性框架。尽管现有方法已展现出良好效果，但其在未见过的规范和多样化环境中的泛化能力尚未得到充分理解。本研究提出SpecRLBench——一个专门用于评估基于LTL的规范引导强化学习方法泛化能力的基准测试平台。该基准涵盖导航与操作领域的不同难度层级，包含静态与动态环境、多样化的机器人动力学模型以及多模态观测方式。通过大规模实证评估，我们系统刻画了现有方法的优势与局限，揭示了随着规范复杂度和环境复杂度提升而涌现的新挑战。SpecRLBench为系统性比较提供了结构化平台，并将促进开发更具泛化能力的规范引导强化学习方法。代码发布于https://github.com/BU-DEPEND-Lab/SpecRLBench。

title: FreqCache: Accelerating Embodied VLN Models with Adaptive Frequency-Guided Token Caching
summary: Vision-Language-Navigation (VLN) models exhibit excellent navigation accuracy but incur high computational overhead. Token caching has emerged as a promising training-free strategy to reduce this cost by reusing token computation results; however, existing token caching approaches rely on visual domain methods for cacheable token selection, leading to challenges when adapted to VLN models. 1) Visual domain methods become invalid when there is viewpoint migration. 2) Visual domain methods neglect critical edge information without the aid of additional algorithms. 3) Visual domain methods overlook the temporal variation of scenarios and lack adjustability in cache budgets. In this paper, we develop detailed analyses and find that the impacts of these challenges exhibit invariance and analyzability in the frequency domain. Based on these, we propose a frequency-guided token caching framework, called FreqCache. Utilizing the inherent properties of the frequency domain, FreqCache achieves optimal token cache establishment, refreshment, and adaptive adjustment. Experiments show that FreqCache achieves 1.59x speedup with ignorable overhead, showing the effect of integrating frequency domain methods in VLN token caching.
tldr: This paper proposes FreqCache, a frequency-guided token caching framework to accelerate Vision-Language-Navigation (VLN) models by reducing computational overhead, achieving a 1.59x speedup.
tldr_zh: 本文提出FreqCache，一种频率引导的令牌缓存框架，通过降低计算开销来加速视觉语言导航模型，实现了1.59倍的速度提升。
summary_zh: 视觉语言导航模型展现出卓越的导航精度，但存在计算开销高的问题。令牌缓存作为一种无需重新训练的策略，通过复用令牌计算结果来降低计算成本，展现出良好前景；然而，现有的令牌缓存方法依赖视觉领域技术选择可缓存令牌，导致在适配视觉语言导航模型时面临挑战：1）当视角发生迁移时，视觉领域方法失效；2）视觉领域方法未借助额外算法时会忽略关键边缘信息；3）视觉领域方法忽视场景的时间变化特性，且缺乏缓存预算的可调节性。本文通过详细分析发现，这些挑战的影响在频域中表现出不变性与可分析性。基于此，我们提出一种频域引导的令牌缓存框架FreqCache。该框架利用频域固有特性，实现了最优令牌缓存的建立、更新与自适应调整。实验表明，FreqCache在可忽略开销下实现了1.59倍的加速效果，证明了频域方法在视觉语言导航令牌缓存中的整合效能。

title: Betting for Sim-to-Real Performance Evaluation
summary: This paper studies the problem of robot performance evaluation, focusing on how to obtain accurate and efficient estimates of real-world behavior under severe constraints on physical experimentation. Such estimates are essential for benchmarking algorithms, comparing design alternatives, validating controllers, and supporting certification or regulatory decision-making, yet real-world testing with physical robots is often expensive, time-consuming, and safety-limited. To mitigate the scarcity of real-world trials, sim-to-real methodologies are commonly employed, using low-cost simulators to inform, supplement, or prioritize physical experiments. Departing from (and complementary to) existing approaches in variance reduction (e.g., importance-sampling variants) or bias-correction (e.g., through prediction-powered inference or learned control variates), we examine this performance-evaluation problem through the lens of betting. We establish theoretical conditions under which a betting mechanism can yield accurate and efficient estimates (provably outperforming the Monte Carlo estimator) and we characterize how such bets should be constructed. We further develop theoretically grounded yet practically implementable approximations of the ideal bet, and we provide concrete decision rules that diagnose when these approximate betting strategies are working as intended. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods using both synthetic examples and cross-fidelity computational simulators. Notably, we also showcase an illustrative case in which a group of synthetic distributions are used to infer the real-world pick-and-place accuracy of a robotic manipulator, a seemingly unconventional sim-to-real transfer that becomes natural and feasible under the proposed betting perspective. Programs for reproducing empirical results are available at https://github.com/ISUSAIL/Bet4Sim2Real.
tldr: This paper introduces a betting-based framework for performance evaluation in robotics, aiming to reduce the need for expensive real-world testing by leveraging simulations. It proposes a method to construct and validate statistical bets that can more efficiently estimate real-world robot performance from simulator data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于机器人性能评估的基于投注的框架，旨在通过利用仿真来减少昂贵的现实世界测试需求。它提出了一种构建和验证统计投注的方法，可以更有效地从模拟器数据估计现实世界中的机器人性能。
summary_zh: 本文研究机器人性能评估问题，重点关注如何在物理实验受到严格约束的情况下，获取真实场景下机器人行为的准确高效估计。这类估计对于算法基准测试、设计方案比较、控制器验证以及支持认证或监管决策至关重要，但使用物理机器人进行实际测试往往成本高昂、耗时且受限于安全因素。为缓解真实世界试验的稀缺性，仿真到现实方法常被采用，即通过低成本仿真器来指导、补充或优先安排物理实验。不同于（且互补于）现有方差缩减（例如重要性采样变体）或偏差校正（例如通过预测驱动推断或学习控制变量）方法，我们通过投注视角审视这一性能评估问题。我们建立了投注机制能够产生准确高效估计（可证明优于蒙特卡洛估计器）的理论条件，并刻画了此类投注的构建方式。我们进一步提出了理想投注的理论基础坚实且实际可实现的近似方法，并提供具体的决策规则以诊断这些近似投注策略是否按预期运行。我们通过合成算例和跨保真度计算仿真器验证了所提方法的有效性。值得注意的是，我们还展示了一个示例案例：利用一组合成分布推断机器人操作器在真实世界中的抓放精度——这种看似非常规的仿真到现实迁移，在提出的投注视角下变得自然且可行。复现实证结果的程序代码可在 https://github.com/ISUSAIL/Bet4Sim2Real 获取。

title: Passage-Aware Structural Mapping for RGB-D Visual SLAM
summary: Doorways and passages are critical structural elements for indoor robot navigation, yet they remain underexplored in modern Visual SLAM (VSLAM) frameworks. This paper presents a passage-aware structural mapping approach for RGB-D VSLAM that detects doors and traversable openings by jointly fusing geometric, semantic, and topological cues. Doors are modeled as planar entities embedded within walls and classified as traversable or non-traversable based on their coplanarity with the supporting wall. Passages are inferred through two complementary strategies: traversal evidence accumulated from camera-wall interactions across consecutive keyframes, and geometric opening validation based on discontinuities in the mapped wall geometry. The proposed method is integrated into vS-Graphs as a proof of concept, enriching its scene graph with passage-level abstractions and improving room connectivity modeling. Qualitative evaluations on indoor office sequences demonstrate reliable doorway detection, and the framework lays the foundation for exploiting these elements in BIM-informed VSLAM. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/snt-arg/visual_sgraphs/tree/doorway_integration.
tldr: The paper introduces a passage-aware mapping method for RGB-D Visual SLAM that detects and models doorways to improve scene graph representations for indoor navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于RGB-D视觉SLAM的通道感知结构建图方法，可检测和建模门道，以改进室内导航的场景图表示。
summary_zh: 门道与通道是室内机器人导航的关键结构要素，然而在现代视觉SLAM（VSLAM）框架中仍未得到充分探索。本文提出了一种面向RGB-D VSLAM的通道感知结构建图方法，通过融合几何、语义与拓扑线索实现门体与可通行开口的检测。门体被建模为嵌入墙体内部的平面实体，并依据其与支撑墙面的共面关系被分类为可通行或不可通行。通道推断通过两种互补策略实现：基于连续关键帧间相机-墙体交互积累的通行证据，以及基于已建图墙体几何不连续性的开口几何验证。所提方法作为概念验证集成于vS-Graphs系统，通过通道级抽象丰富了场景图谱并改善了房间连通性建模。在室内办公场景序列上的定性评估验证了门道检测的可靠性，该框架为在建筑信息模型增强的VSLAM中利用这些结构要素奠定了基础。源代码已公开于https://github.com/snt-arg/visual_sgraphs/tree/doorway_integration。

title: Real-time windrow detection from onboard tractor sensors for automated following
summary: Proprietary design in commercial windrow-detection systems restricts transparency and limits progress in open autonomous forage-harvesting research. We present a multi-modal dataset combining stereo vision and LiDAR from tractor-mounted sensors during real baling operations. The dataset includes synchronized sensor data with GNSS trajectories, partly released as ROS2 Humble bags on Zenodo, with additional data available on request. Using this dataset, we implement a real-time (>20 Hz) centroid-based windrow-following method on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Across the critical 4-10 m guidance range, stereo and LiDAR depth measurements show strong agreement (0.965 +/- 0.021), indicating that low-cost stereo sensors can approach LiDAR performance. Our open-source ROS 2 pipeline provides a reproducible benchmark for GPS-free windrow detection and supports development of practical autonomous forage-harvesting systems. Dataset: https://zenodo.org/records/17486318
tldr: This paper presents an open-source, real-time multi-modal perception system for automated windrow-following using stereo vision and LiDAR on a tractor, including a dataset and ROS 2 pipeline for autonomous forage harvesting.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于自动跟随干草行的开源、实时多模态感知系统，在拖拉机上使用立体视觉和LiDAR，并包含一个数据集和ROS 2管线，用于自主饲料收割。
summary_zh: 商业成行探测系统中的专有设计限制了透明度，并阻碍了开放式自主饲草收获研究的发展。我们提出了一个多模态数据集，该数据集结合了真实打捆作业期间拖拉机搭载传感器的立体视觉和激光雷达数据。该数据集包含与GNSS轨迹同步的传感器数据，其中部分已作为ROS2 Humble数据包在Zenodo上发布，更多数据可根据需求提供。利用此数据集，我们在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上实现了一种基于质心的实时（>20 Hz）成行跟随方法。在关键的4-10米引导距离范围内，立体视觉与激光雷达的深度测量结果高度一致（0.965 +/- 0.021），表明低成本立体传感器可接近激光雷达的性能水平。我们开源的ROS 2流水线为无需GPS的成行检测提供了可复现的基准，并支持实用自主饲草收获系统的开发。数据集：https://zenodo.org/records/17486318

title: Leveraging Human Feedback for Semantically-Relevant Skill Discovery
summary: Unsupervised skill discovery in reinforcement learning aims to intrinsically motivate agents to discover diverse and useful behaviours. However, unconstrained approaches can produce unsafe, unethical, or misaligned behaviours. To mitigate these risks and improve the practical desireability of discovered skills, recent work grounds the discovery process by leveraging human preference feedback. However, preference-based approaches are feedback-inefficient and inherently ill-equipped to deal with skill spaces composed of a variety of different skills such as running, jumping, walking, etc. To overcome this limitation, we introduce semantic labelling, a novel and feedback-efficient approach that leverages human cognitive strengths to identify and label semantically meaningful behaviours. Based on semantic labelling, we propose Semantically Relevant Skill Discovery (SRSD), a novel human-in-the-loop approach that collects semantic labels from human feedback and learns a reward function to encourage skills to be more semantically diverse and relevant. Through our experiments in a 2D navigation environment and four locomotion environments, we demonstrate that SRSD can improve semantic diversity and discover relevant behaviours while scaling effectively to a large variety of behaviours.
tldr: The paper introduces a human-in-the-loop skill discovery method, SRSD, which uses semantic labels from human feedback to guide reinforcement learning agents towards discovering more diverse and relevant behaviors, tested in 2D navigation and locomotion environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种人机回路的技能发现方法SRSD，它利用人类反馈的语义标签来引导强化学习代理发现更多样且相关的行为，并在2D导航和运动环境中进行了测试。

title: Computational Design and Co-Robotic Fabrication for Material Reuse in Architecture
summary:
Climate change and resource depletion demand a shift from the dominant linear "take-make-use-dispose" paradigm of construction toward circular, low-waste practices. Material reuse offers a promising pathway by reducing raw material extraction, mitigating waste, and extending the service lifespan of carbon-sequestering materials such as timber. Realizing this potential, however, requires addressing technical and logistical challenges across both design and construction for accommodating heterogeneous, reclaimed material inventories.
  This paper presents an integrated framework that couples data-driven computational design with feedback-driven adaptive human-robot collaborative (co-robotic) fabrication and assembly to enable the realization of nonstandard structures made from reclaimed timber of varying length and geometries, supplemented with new off-the-shelf timber when necessary. The framework is validated through Timbrelyn, a built case-study installation that demonstrates how timber reuse can inform and enhance architectural expression. This work contributes to the development of integrated design-to-fabrication workflows that advance adaptive, feedback-driven methods to handle inventory constraints and reclaimed material uncertainties, facilitating material reuse in the design and construction of new buildings and structures.
tldr: This paper presents a computational design and co-robotic fabrication framework for building nonstandard structures from reclaimed timber, validated with a physical installation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个计算设计与协同机器人制造的框架，利用回收木材建造非标准结构，并通过实体装置验证。

title: An Automatic Ground Collision Avoidance System with Reinforcement Learning
summary: This article evaluates an artificial intelligence (AI)-based Automatic Ground Collision Avoidance System (AGCAS) designed for advanced jet trainers to enhance operational effectiveness. In the continuously evolving field of aerospace engineering, the integration of AI is crucial for advancing operations with improved timing constraints and efficiency. Our study explores the design process of an AI-driven AGCAS, specifically tailored for advanced jet trainers, focusing on addressing the AGCAS problem within a limited observation space. The system utilizes line-of-sight queries on a terrain server to ensure precise and efficient collision avoidance. This approach aims to significantly improve the safety and operational capabilities of advanced jet trainers.
tldr: This paper explores an AI-driven Automatic Ground Collision Avoidance System for advanced jet trainers, using terrain server queries and reinforcement learning to improve safety and operational efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了一种用于高级喷气式教练机的人工智能驱动自动地面防撞系统，利用地形服务器查询和强化学习来提高安全性和操作效率。

title: Pedestrians play chicken with an autonomous vehicle
summary: Automated vehicles (AVs) are commonly programmed to yield unconditionally to pedestrians in the interest of safety. However, this design choice can give rise to the Freezing Robot Problem in which pedestrians learn to assert priority at every interaction, causing vehicles to stall and make no progress. The game theoretic Sequential Chicken model has shown that, like human drivers, AVs can resolve this problem by trading credible threats of very small risks of collision or larger risks of less severe invasion of personal space against the value of time due to yielding delays. This paper presents the first demonstration and evaluation of this approach using a real AV with human subjects and shows that pedestrian behavior under experimentally constrained safety conditions can be well fitted by Sequential Chicken, with a low time value of collision, suggestive of their planning to avoid proxemic personal space penalties as well as actual collisions.
tldr: This paper investigates the 'Freezing Robot Problem' in autonomous vehicles, where unconditional yielding to pedestrians leads to traffic flow issues. It proposes and validates a game-theoretic 'Sequential Chicken' model, demonstrating on a real AV with human subjects that strategic, small threats can improve efficiency while maintaining safety.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了自动驾驶汽车无条件礼让行人导致的'冻结机器人问题'，提出并验证了一种博弈论'序贯胆小鬼'模型。通过在真实自动驾驶车辆上进行人体实验，证明策略性的轻微威胁可以提高交通效率，同时保障安全。

title: Trajectory Planning for an Articulated Commercial Vehicle using Model Predictive Contouring Control
summary: This paper presents a trajectory planning method for articulated commercial vehicles, specifically tractor-semitrailers, based on Model Predictive Contouring Control (MPCC). Although MPCC has proven effective for passenger cars, it is generally ill-suited for tractor-semitrailers. These vehicles are significantly larger, the semitrailer follows a different path than the tractor, and reversing maneuvers are unstable and prone to jackknifing. Furthermore, practical driving scenarios often require scenario-dependent prioritization of different vehicle `anchor points', e.g., prioritizing the semitrailer position during docking or the tractor position when parking to charge. Therefore, we extend MPCC to enable scenario-dependent weighting of these anchor points and incorporate explicit road-boundary constraints for the front and rear tractor axles and the semitrailer axle, thereby ensuring that all considered wheels remain within the drivable area. The simulation results demonstrate the successful navigation of a representative logistic scenario in both forward and reverse direction. Furthermore, the influence of the optimization parameters on the trajectories is analyzed, providing insights into controlling the vehicle behavior. Finally, first tests using a full-scale prototype vehicle show the practical applicability of the approach.
authors: M. J. G. van de Molengraft
tldr: This paper extends Model Predictive Contouring Control for trajectory planning of articulated commercial vehicles, enabling scenario-specific weighting of vehicle anchor points and enforcing road boundary constraints for all axles, validated in simulation and on a prototype.
tldr_zh: 本文扩展了模型预测轮廓控制方法，用于铰接式商用车辆的轨迹规划，支持场景相关的车辆锚点加权和所有车轴的道路边界约束，并通过仿真和原型车验证了其应用性。

title: Towards Lawful Autonomous Driving: Deriving Scenario-Aware Driving Requirements from Traffic Laws and Regulations
summary: Driving in compliance with traffic laws and regulations is a basic requirement for human drivers, yet autonomous vehicles (AVs) can violate these requirements in diverse real-world scenarios. To encode law compliance into AV systems, conventional approaches use formal logic languages to explicitly specify behavioral constraints, but this process is labor-intensive, hard to scale, and costly to maintain. With recent advances in artificial intelligence, it is promising to leverage large language models (LLMs) to derive legal requirements from traffic laws and regulations. However, without explicitly grounding and reasoning in structured traffic scenarios, LLMs often retrieve irrelevant provisions or miss applicable ones, yielding imprecise requirements. To address this, we propose a novel pipeline that grounds LLM reasoning in a traffic scenario taxonomy through node-wise anchors that encode hierarchical semantics. On Chinese traffic laws and OnSite dataset (5,897 scenarios), our method improves law-scenario matching by 29.1\% and increases the accuracy of derived mandatory and prohibitive requirements by 36.9\% and 38.2\%, respectively. We further demonstrate real-world applicability by constructing a law-compliance layer for AV navigation and developing an onboard, real-time compliance monitor for in-field testing, providing a solid foundation for future AV development, deployment, and regulatory oversight.
tldr: This paper proposes a method using LLMs grounded in a traffic scenario taxonomy to derive precise driving requirements from traffic laws for autonomous vehicles, improving law-scenario matching and requirement accuracy, and demonstrates its application in a real-time AV compliance monitor.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种方法，通过将大语言模型在交通场景分类中锚定，从交通法规中推导出精确的自动驾驶要求，提高了法律-场景匹配度和要求准确性，并展示了其在实时AV合规监控中的应用。

title: PhysNote: Self-Knowledge Notes for Evolvable Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language Model
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on textbook-style physics problems, yet they frequently fail when confronted with dynamic real-world scenarios that require temporal consistency and causal reasoning across frames. We identify two fundamental challenges underlying these failures: (1) spatio-temporal identity drift, where objects lose their physical identity across successive frames and break causal chains, and (2) volatility of inference-time insights, where a model may occasionally produce correct physical reasoning but never consolidates it for future reuse. To address these challenges, we propose PhysNote, an agentic framework that enables VLMs to externalize and refine physical knowledge through self-generated "Knowledge Notes." PhysNote stabilizes dynamic perception through spatio-temporal canonicalization, organizes self-generated insights into a hierarchical knowledge repository, and drives an iterative reasoning loop that grounds hypotheses in visual evidence before consolidating verified knowledge. Experiments on PhysBench demonstrate that PhysNote achieves 56.68% overall accuracy, a 4.96% improvement over the best multi-agent baseline, with consistent gains across all four physical reasoning domains.
tldr: This paper proposes PhysNote, a framework to improve VLMs' physical reasoning in dynamic scenarios by having them create and refine external 'Knowledge Notes' to address identity drift and consolidate correct reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PhysNote框架，通过让视觉语言模型（VLM）创建并优化外部“知识笔记”，以解决动态场景中的身份漂移问题并巩固正确推理，从而提升其在物理推理方面的能力。

title: Grounding Before Generalizing: How AI Differs from Humans in Causal Transfer
summary: Extracting abstract causal structures and applying them to novel situations is a hallmark of human intelligence. While Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong performance on a wide range of reasoning tasks, their capacity for interactive causal learning -- inducing latent structures through sequential exploration and transferring them across contexts -- remains uncharacterized. Human learners accomplish such transfer after minimal exposure, whereas classical Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents fail catastrophically. Whether state-of-the-art Artificial Intelligence (AI) models possess human-like mechanisms for abstract causal structure transfer is an open question. Using the OpenLock paradigm requiring sequential discovery of Common Cause (CC) and Common Effect (CE) structures, here we show that models exhibit fundamentally delayed or absent transfer: even successful models require initial environmental-specific mapping -- what we term environmental grounding -- before efficiency gains emerge, whereas humans leverage prior structural knowledge from the very first solution attempt. In the text-only condition, models matched or exceeded human discovery efficiency. In contrast, visual information -- in both the image-only and text-and-image conditions -- overall degraded rather than enhanced performance, revealing a broad reliance on symbolic processing rather than integrated multimodal reasoning. Models further exhibited systematic CC/CE asymmetries absent in humans, suggesting heuristic biases rather than direction-neutral causal abstraction. These findings reveal that large-scale statistical learning does not produce the decontextualized causal schemas underpinning human analogical reasoning, establishing grounding-dependent transfer as a fundamental limitation of current LLMs and VLMs.
tldr: The paper investigates the capacity of LLMs and VLMs for interactive causal learning and transfer, comparing them to human performance. It finds that models require environmental grounding before transfer, lack integrated multimodal reasoning, and exhibit systematic biases, unlike humans.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文研究了大型语言模型和视觉语言模型在交互式因果学习与迁移方面的能力，并与人类表现进行比较。研究发现，模型需要先进行环境特定映射才能迁移，缺乏整合的多模态推理，且存在系统性偏差，与人类不同。

title: WildLIFT: Lifting monocular drone video to 3D for species-agnostic wildlife monitoring
summary: Monocular RGB cameras mounted on drones are widely used for wildlife monitoring, yet most analytical pipelines remain confined to two-dimensional image space, leaving geometric information in video underexploited. We present WildLIFT, a computational framework that integrates three-dimensional scene geometry from monocular drone video with open-vocabulary 2D instance segmentation to enable species-agnostic 3D detection and tracking. Oriented 3D bounding box labels with semantic face information enable quantitative assessment of viewpoint coverage and inter-animal occlusion, producing structured metadata for downstream ecological analyses. We validate the framework on 2,581 manually curated frames comprising over 6,700 3D detections across four large mammal species. WildLIFT maintains high identity consistency in multi-animal scenes and substantially reduces manual 3D annotation effort through keyframe-based refinement. By transforming standard drone footage into structured 3D and viewpoint-aware representations, WildLIFT extends the analytical utility of aerial wildlife datasets for behavioural research and population monitoring.
tldr: WildLIFT is a framework that uses monocular drone video and open-vocabulary segmentation to create 3D detections and tracking for wildlife monitoring, generating structured metadata for ecological analysis.
tldr_zh: WildLIFT是一个利用单目无人机视频和开放词汇分割进行野生动物3D检测与追踪的框架，为生态分析生成结构化元数据。

title: Improving Vision-language Models with Perception-centric Process Reward Models
summary: Recent advancements in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) have significantly improved the complex reasoning ability of vision-language models (VLMs). However, its outcome-level supervision is too coarse to diagnose and correct errors within the reasoning chain. To this end, we propose Perceval, a process reward model (PRM) that enables token-level error grounding, which can extract image-related claims from the response and compare them one by one with the visual evidence in the image, ultimately returning claims that contain perceptual errors. Perceval is trained with perception-intensive supervised training data. We then integrate Perceval into the RL training process to train the policy models. Specifically, compared to traditional GRPO, which applies sequence-level advantages, we apply token-level advantages by targeting penalties on hallucinated spans identified by Perceval, thus enabling fine-grained supervision signals. In addition to augmenting the training process, Perceval can also assist VLMs during the inference stage. Using Perceval, we can truncate the erroneous portions of the model's response, and then either have the model regenerate the response directly or induce the model to reflect on its previous output. This process can be repeated multiple times to achieve test-time scaling. Experiments show significant improvements on benchmarks from various domains across multiple reasoning VLMs trained with RL, highlighting the promise of perception-centric supervision as a general-purpose strategy. For test-time scaling, it also demonstrates consistent performance gains over other strategies, such as major voting. Our code and data will be publicly released at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/Perceval.
tldr: This paper introduces Perceval, a process reward model for vision-language models that grounds perceptual errors at the token level and integrates this fine-grained supervision into RL training and inference to improve reasoning. It focuses on vision-language reasoning benchmarks without explicit application to robotics or embodied control.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Perceval，一种用于视觉语言模型的进程奖励模型，它在令牌层面定位感知错误，并将这种细粒度监督整合到RL训练和推理中以改进推理能力。工作重点是基于视觉语言推理的基准测试，未明确涉及机器人或具身控制应用。

title: AutoGUI-v2: A Comprehensive Multi-Modal GUI Functionality Understanding Benchmark
summary: Autonomous agents capable of navigating Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) hold the potential to revolutionize digital productivity. However, achieving true digital autonomy extends beyond reactive element matching; it necessitates a predictive mental model of interface dynamics and the ability to foresee the "digital world state" resulting from interactions. Despite the perceptual capabilities of modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs), existing benchmarks remain bifurcated (focusing either on black-box task completion or static, shallow grounding), thereby failing to assess whether agents truly comprehend the implicit functionality and transition logic of GUIs. To bridge this gap, we introduce AutoGUI-v2, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate deep GUI functionality understanding and interaction outcome prediction. We construct the benchmark using a novel VLM-human collaborative pipeline that recursively parses multi-platform screenshots into hierarchical functional regions to generate diverse evaluation tasks. Providing 2,753 tasks across six operating systems, AutoGUI-v2 rigorously tests agents on region and element-level semantics, grounding, and dynamic state prediction. Our evaluation reveals a striking dichotomy in VLMs: while open-source models fine-tuned on agent data (e.g., Qwen3-VL) excel at functional grounding, commercial models (e.g., Gemini-2.5-Pro-Thinking) dominate in functionality captioning. Crucially, all models struggle with complex interaction logic of uncommon actions, highlighting that deep functional understanding remains a significant hurdle. By systematically measuring these foundational capabilities, AutoGUI-v2 offers a new lens for advancing the next generation of GUI agents.
tldr: This paper introduces AutoGUI-v2, a benchmark designed to evaluate deep GUI functionality understanding and interaction outcome prediction for autonomous digital agents, revealing limitations in current Vision-Language Models on complex tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了AutoGUI-v2，一个用于评估自主数字代理对GUI深层功能理解和交互结果预测的基准测试，揭示了当前视觉语言模型在复杂任务上的局限性。

title: Hybrid A*-Based Reverse Path-Planning of a Vehicle with Trailer System
summary: Reverse parking maneuvering of a vehicle with trailer system is a difficult task to complete for human drivers due to the multi-body nature of the system and the unintuitive controls required to orientate the trailer properly. The problem is complicated with the presence of other vehicles that the trailer and its connected vehicle must avoid during the reverse parking maneuver. While path planning methods in reverse motion for vehicles with trailers exist, there is a lack of results that also offer collision avoidance as part of the algorithm. This paper hence proposes a modified Hybrid A*-based algorithm that can accommodate the vehicle-trailer system as well as collision avoidance considerations with the other vehicles and obstacles in the parking environment. One of the novelties of this proposed approach is its adaptability to the vehicle with trailer system, where limits of usable steering input that prevent the occurrence of jackknife incidents vary with respect to system configuration. The other contribution is the addition of the collision avoidance functionality which the standard Hybrid A* algorithm lacks. The method is developed and presented first, followed by simulation case studies to demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed approach.
tldr: This paper proposes a modified Hybrid A* algorithm for reverse path planning and collision avoidance for vehicle-trailer systems, particularly in parking scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种改进的Hybrid A*算法，用于带拖挂车辆的倒车路径规划和碰撞避免，尤其适用于停车场景。

title: ARETE: Attention-based Rasterized Encoding for Topology Estimation using HSV-transformed Crowdsourced Vehicle Fleet Data
summary: The continuous advancement of autonomous driving (AD) introduces challenges across multiple disciplines to ensure safe and efficient driving. One such challenge is the generation of High-Definition (HD) maps, which must remain up to date and highly accurate for downstream automotive tasks. One promising approach is the use of crowdsourced data from a vehicle fleet, representing road topology and lane-level features. This work focuses on the generation of centerlines and lane dividers from crowdsourced vehicle trajectories. We adopt a Detection Transformer (DETR)-based approach, where a rasterized representation of vehicle trajectories is used as input to predict vectorized lane representations. Each lane consists of a centerline with an associated direction and corresponding lane dividers that are geometrically constrained by the centerline. Our method includes the extraction of local tiles, from which crowdsourced vehicle trajectories are aggregated. Each tile undergoes a transformation into a rasterized representation encoding both the presence and direction of each trajectory, enabling the prediction of vectorized directed lanes. Experiments are conducted on an internal dataset as well as on the public datasets nuScenes and nuPlan.
tldr: This paper proposes a method for generating HD maps (centerlines and lane dividers) from crowdsourced vehicle trajectory data using a DETR-based approach, applied to autonomous driving datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于DETR的方法，利用众包车辆轨迹数据生成高精地图（中心线和车道分隔线），并在自动驾驶数据集上进行了实验。

title: Projected Attainable Speed Space: A Driving Efficiency Metric Connecting Instantaneous Evaluation to Travel Time
summary: Inefficient driving behaviors, such as overly conservative yielding, remain a key obstacle to deployment of autonomous vehicles (AVs). Instantaneous driving efficiency metrics are crucial for self-driving decision-making because they affect real-time performance evaluation and control optimization. However, commonly used indicators, including speed, relative speed, and inter-vehicle distance, are limited in capturing traffic context and in ensuring consistency between instantaneous outputs and travel-level outcomes. This study proposes the Projected Attainable Speed Space (PASS) model, a unified framework for driving efficiency assessment across instantaneous and travel-level analyses by integrating kinematic and spatial traffic information. PASS characterizes instantaneous driving efficiency with two coupled elements: potential for speed improvement (available acceleration space) and response to that potential (utilization of available acceleration space). Available acceleration space is referenced to projected attainable speed, derived from an idealized catch-up maneuver using relative speed and spacing to the leading vehicle; utilization is represented by the temporal change in available acceleration space. To ensure cross-scale consistency, time-aggregated PASS is defined as a travel-level efficiency metric. Trajectory data from a driving simulation experiment are used for parameter calibration to maximize agreement between time-aggregated PASS and observed travel times. Across 10 lane-change events, results show strong consistency, with an average coefficient of determination of 0.913, validating PASS for consistent efficiency evaluation across instantaneous and travel-level temporal scales. This study provides a unified, physically grounded framework that supports real-time decision-making and long-term performance analysis in autonomous driving.
tldr: This paper introduces the Projected Attainable Speed Space (PASS) model, a unified framework for evaluating driving efficiency in autonomous vehicles across instantaneous and travel-level timescales, validated on driving simulation data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了投影可达到速度空间模型，这是一个用于评估自动驾驶车辆在瞬时和行程层面驾驶效率的统一框架，并通过驾驶模拟数据进行了验证。

title: OpenPodcar2: a robust, ROS2 vehicle for self-driving research
summary: OpenPodcar2 is a robust, ROS2-interfaced, low-cost, open source hardware and software, autonomous vehicle platform based on an off-the-shelf, hard-canopy, mobility scooter donor vehicle. It is a modification of the previous OpenPodcar design, which extends it with robust electronics and ROS2 interfacing, to enable both research and also potential deployment use cases. The platform consists of (a) hardware components: documented as a bill of materials and build instructions; (b) integration to the general purpose OSH R4 mechatronics board and a Gazebo simulation of the vehicle, both presenting a common ROS2 interface (c) higher-level ROS2 software implementations and configurations of standard robot autonomous planning and control, including the nav2 stack which performs SLAM and enacts commands to drive the vehicle from a current to a desired pose around obstacles. OpenPodcar2 can transport a human passenger or similar load at speeds up to 15km/h, for example for use as a last-mile autonomous taxi service or to transport delivery containers similarly around a city center. It is small and safe enough to be parked in a standard research lab robust enough for some deployment cases. Total build cost was around 7,000USD from new components, or 2,000USD with a used Donor Vehicle. OpenPodcar2 thus provides a research balance between real world utility, safety, cost and robustness.
tldr: OpenPodcar2 is an open-source, ROS2-based autonomous vehicle platform built from a mobility scooter, designed for research and potential deployment in applications like autonomous last-mile transport.
tldr_zh: OpenPodcar2是一个基于移动踏板车构建的、开源的、基于ROS2的自动驾驶车辆平台，专为研究和潜在的最后一英里自主运输等部署应用而设计。

title: Supporting Family-School Partnerships with Robot-Facilitated Home-Based Activities
summary: Family-school partnerships (FSP) are critical to children's development, yet families often face barriers such as time constraints, fragmented communication, and limited opportunities for meaningful engagement. As a step toward facilitating broader family-school partnerships, we explore a novel approach that integrates a social robot into family settings, specifically supporting home-based activities. Through interviews and co-design sessions, we designed and developed a robotic system informed by both parents and children, that supported, among other interactions, family communication about school topics. We evaluated the robot in a week-long, in-home study with 10 families. Our findings show how families integrated the robot into daily life, how parental facilitation styles shaped use, and how families perceived both the helpfulness and challenges of the robot.
